Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original northern survival game environment background. This is an ENVIRONMENT ART ASSET, not a screenshot or interface.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for soft stylized snowy game scenery and readable paths. Input image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for soft rounded 3D forms and smooth toy-like materials. Do not reproduce any character, object identity, interface or text from either reference.
Style/medium: polished stylized 3D mobile game environment, friendly and colorful, softly rounded low-detail shapes with smooth bevels, thick pillowy snow and gentle dimensional lighting. NO angular outlined graphic-novel art; NO hard faceted low-poly slabs. Blue and pale turquoise shadows, pastel cyan snow highlights, warm amber accent light. Snow looks soft and plush, rocks and wood have rounded crafted silhouettes. Bright, cute, inviting northern adventure.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9 composition, preferably 1536x864 or another wide native canvas. Slightly elevated three-quarter view across an open snowy ground toward a distinct northern vista, usable as a game stage. Leave the central lower half mostly open simple snow/path for later character sprites; put distinctive scenery toward sides and upper half. Coherent full-bleed scene, no panels or margins.
Lighting/mood: clear soft daylight, cool-blue snow shadows, warm amber points. Enough color and contrast to read at small size.
Constraints: NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO cart, NO battle scene, NO UI, NO frames, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO buttons, NO watermark. Do not generate a reference screenshot. Make a new independent environment image.
Scene/backdrop: RIME SHORE — a snow-covered beach along a cold teal northern sea. Curved snowy shoreline on the right opening onto gently rippled turquoise-blue water, rounded dark shore rocks capped with soft snow, a small simple weathered lighthouse/beacon on the left upper side casting an amber glow, distant pale snowy island cliffs beyond the sea. Sparse tiny winter pines only at far left. A wide open white-blue snowbank/path in the central foreground. Coastal horizon and sea should dominate, very clearly a snowy BEACH, not a forest or mountain road.
